item.title: Indian River County responds to Vero Beach condo owner concerns over waste management fee spike
item.description: A Vero Beach condo owner saw his monthly waste management fees jump from $11 to $21 under a new contract with Waste Management that began in October 2025.

item.title: St. Lucie County Clerk's website back online after temporary redirection issue
item.description: The St. Lucie County Clerk and Comptroller's website was down for hours Tuesday morning, redirecting visitors to another site before coming back online around 1:30 p.m.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to stunning 3-2 comeback over Egypt to reach World Cup quarterfinals
item.description: Messi scored his record-extending 21st World Cup goal in the 83rd minute as Argentina rallied from a 2-0 deficit with 11 minutes remaining in regulation.

item.title: Fort Pierce man, 28, dies after weekend shooting on South 14th Street
item.description: A 28-year-old man died Tuesday after he was shot multiple times in Fort Pierce early Sunday morning, according to police.

item.title: Fort Pierce man, 66, killed in shooting on Essex Drive; suspect in custody
